items.title: CarMax Stock Rises on Earnings Beat. There’s 1 Big Sign the Turnaround Is Working.
items.summary: Shares of  CarMax  rose Tuesday after the used-car retailer posted better-than-expected fiscal second-quarter earnings and said it plans to resume repurchasing shares.  CarMax stock advanced 3.5% to $58.58 on Tuesday after ending Monday down 1.2%.  CarMax posted adjusted earnings of $1.16 a share in the quarter ended Aug. 31, up from 64 cents a share a year ago and above Wall Street’s expectation of 73 cents.
